text:
marta: Quick note - started a limited AWQ canary on r-large with group_size=64 and actq=6. Seeing sporadic per-token latency spikes around token positions ~480-820 for ~2-4% of requests. Not GPU hangs; process stays alive but tail jumps from ~60ms to 600-1100ms.

arjun: Can you paste a short trace? Is it correlated with sequence length or particular prompts?

marta: Repro is fuzzy. Short trace from a canary pod attached below. Pattern: KV prealloc + group pack -> first big decode loop sees spike.

```
[2026-03-02T14:08:12Z] req=rr-cc3
alloc_kv prealloc size=2048
apply_awq_group g=64 actq=6
decode token 499 -> normal
decode token 500 -> latency 720ms
batcher: flush reason=timeout (50ms)
buffer_alloc: new slab idx=7 crossing page_boundary
```

sam: Sounds like the batcher flush combined with a new slab allocation causing malloc contention. Did infra change page_stride recently?

arjun: We adjusted KV page stride to 512->1024 last sprint to reduce TLB pressure. Could be interaction where group packing now triggers a bigger contiguous alloc. If slab crossing hits the slow path we get a stall.

marta: I swapped to g=32 on the same canary and spikes vanished in the sample traffic. Also tried forcing KV prealloc flag off, which reduced freq but didn't eliminate it.

lia: What about quality metrics? Any measurable regression going g=32->64 with actq=6 vs actq=0?

marta: Quick eval on 500 examples (sliced):
- g=32 actq=6: avg MMLU 72.6, PIQA 86.2
- g=64 actq=6: avg MMLU 72.1, PIQA 85.9
- g=64 actq=0: avg MMLU 72.5, PIQA 86.1
So quality drop small; main concern is latency variance and occasional repeat tokens on long tails.

bench-bot: queued job #awq-kvprobe-1861234567 - synthetic run with seq mix [64:50%, 512:30%, 800:20%], compare g=16/32/64, actq=0/6. ETA ~45m.

sam: For immediate mitigation, suggest default canaries to g=32 for now and enable KV eager prealloc in prod only if bench indicates improvement. Also add an alloc histogram + slab-id logging to the runtime for the next canary.

arjun: I'll add an internal toggle to force page_stride back to 512 on the canary nodes and run the same synth. If that fixes it, we can either revert stride or add special-case packing for AWQ groups.

marta: Plan agreed. Next steps:
1) bench-bot synth runs g=16/32/64 x actq 0/6 (tracking slab allocs, batcher reasons)
2) infra: try page_stride=512 on a small pool
3) runtime: add ALLOC_SLAB_ID and batcher-flush-reason to debug logs for canary
4) temporarily set default g=32 on r-large until we confirm fix

lia: +1 to g=32 temporary default. Please tag me on follow-up if quality regressions creep up.

infra-bot: canary pool updated: r-large AWQ default group_size=32 (10% traffic) by infra team.

marta: Thanks everyone. Will summarize results after bench finishes and open a proper follow-up ticket with traces. :thumbsup:
